englishTranslation: Broken rice with pork chop, shredded pork, and egg meatloaf
atAGlance: Cơm tấm bì chả sườn is a loaded broken-rice plate: grilled pork chop, shredded pork skin, steamed egg meatloaf, pickles, scallion oil, and fish-sauce dressing.
whatItIs: Cơm tấm bì chả sườn is a southern broken-rice plate with grilled pork chop, shredded pork skin, egg meatloaf, pickles, scallion oil, and fish-sauce dressing.
howToEnjoy: Use the nước mắm to season the broken rice, then rotate bites of grilled pork chop, shredded pork skin, steamed egg loaf, pickles, and scallion oil.
howLocalsOrder: Order cơm tấm bì chả sườn when you want the full texture set without the fried-egg add-on. Ask for fish-sauce dressing on the side or extra pickles before the plate is dressed.
worthKnowing: Cơm tấm began with broken rice grains from milling, associated with southern Vietnam and Saigon working-day eating. Bì, chả, and sườn show how a humble rice base became a beloved loaded plate.
goodToKnow: Bì is shredded pork skin with toasted rice powder; chả is the steamed egg-and-pork loaf.
travelerCaution: Contains pork, egg, and fish sauce.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm tấm bì chả sườn.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of broken rice with pork chop, shredded pork, and egg meatloaf.
